overview_description.description: Our vision is to empower individuals affected by the criminal justice system to navigate and advocate for themselves with confidence and dignity. We strive to create a system where individuals are treated fairly and have access to the necessary resources and support to effectively participate in the justice process. Our ultimate goal is to create a criminal justice system that is truly just and equitable for all.
